summary.zh: 评估供应商表现与 SLA 履约情况
summary.en: Score vendors, track SLA compliance and classify third-party risk.

description.zh: 为供应商建立评分卡，跟踪 SLA 履约与服务抵扣，划分第三方风险等级，并支持一级供应商的年度评审。适合供应商续约、年度复盘或采购合规检查时使用。
description.en: Builds vendor scorecards, tracks SLA compliance and service credits, and tiers third-party risk ahead of reviews. Fits renewals, annual vendor reviews and procurement compliance checks.
